title: Advanced Shield
intro: Advanced Shield is a Shield item which can be crafted and equipped by the Player. It grants 1,800 Shield while equipped and has 21,000 durability. It's an upgrade from the Ultra Shield and is superseded by the Ancient Shield. Equipping the shield in the inventory will charge up the shield. While charged, the shield will absorb any attacks at the cost of some of its charge. It does not absorb fall damage and starvation damage. When the player is not attacked for [25 seconds?], the shield recharges itself automatically.
description: Strange shield made with advanced technology. It automatically repairs itself after not taking damage for a while.

This healing ability can be very powerful, especially while using a weapon that deals damage rapidly like the Gatling Gun or Terraprisma. The V1 Armor is a part of the Palworld–ULTRAKILL crossover.
